name: lucy-by-peerbie
description: Your Lucy tasks, recorded meeting and lecture notes, notes pad, routines and calendar in ChatGPT, as yourself and only in your own Lucy space.

interface.longDescription:
Lucy is a personal assistant app. You record a meeting, a lecture or a call, and Lucy turns it into a transcript, a summary and tasks with deadlines, then reminds you until they are done. This plugin brings your Lucy into ChatGPT.

What you can do:
- See what is due today, overdue or coming up, and search your tasks.
- Find what was decided in a meeting or lecture you recorded with Lucy: its summary, key points and action items.
- Turn action items into tasks with due dates, change a task's status or due date, and save a note to your notes pad.
- Look at your next days in the Google or Outlook calendar connected to Lucy.
- See your Lucy routines, set up a new one, or pause one.

How it works: you sign in with your Lucy account and choose read only or read and change. Every request runs as you, inside your own Lucy space, so ChatGPT sees only your own data. ChatGPT asks before any change. Nothing can be deleted through this plugin, and recordings themselves are never shared, only their text.

Who it is for: anyone with a Lucy account. Lucy is available for iPhone and Android.

Limits: task search covers the last 90 days; the calendar shows up to 14 days ahead and needs a calendar connected in Lucy.
capabilities: Search recorded meeting and lecture notes
defaultPrompt: What's due today, and what's overdue?
What were the action items from my last recorded meeting?
Turn the action items from my last meeting into tasks due this week.

positive.prompt: What is overdue for me in Lucy, and what is due today?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the reviewer's open tasks: 'Send the lease renewal form' overdue, 'Submit the Marketing 201 essay outline' due today (high priority), and the tasks due later this week.

positive.prompt: What were the action items from my Marketing 201 lecture?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds 'Marketing 201 - Week 6 lecture' and returns its summary and two action items (read chapter 7 by Monday; draft the essay outline by Thursday).

positive.prompt: Make a task for each action item from my weekly planning call with Sam, with their due dates.
positive.expected_behavior: After confirming with the user, creates two tasks ('Send the budget sheet to Sam', 'Book the venue for the offsite') with the dates from the note. They appear in the Lucy app.

positive.prompt: Move 'Book the dentist appointment' to next Monday.
positive.expected_behavior: After confirming, changes the due date to next Monday and says so.

positive.prompt: Which routines do I have in Lucy?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the routine 'Weekly wrap-up' (every Friday at 17:00, summarises the week) and its status.

negative.prompt: Delete all my overdue tasks in Lucy.
What is the weather in Berlin tomorrow?
Show me Sam's tasks in Lucy.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: read and update your Lucy tasks, recorded meeting and lecture notes, notes pad, routines and connected calendar.

tr-TR.subtitle: Görevler ve toplantı notları
tr-TR.description:
Lucy kişisel bir asistan uygulamasıdır. Bir toplantıyı, dersi ya da görüşmeyi kaydedersiniz; Lucy bunu metne, özete ve son tarihli görevlere dönüştürür, işler bitene kadar size hatırlatır. Bu eklenti Lucy'nizi ChatGPT'ye getirir.

Neler yapabilirsiniz:
- Bugün ne var, ne gecikti, sırada ne var görün; görevlerinizde arama yapın.
- Lucy ile kaydettiğiniz bir toplantıda ya da derste ne kararlaştırıldığını bulun: özet, önemli noktalar ve yapılacaklar.
- Yapılacakları son tarihli görevlere çevirin, bir görevin durumunu ya da tarihini değiştirin, not defterinize not kaydedin.
- Lucy'ye bağlı Google veya Outlook takviminizde önümüzdeki günlere bakın.
- Lucy rutinlerinizi görün, yenisini kurun ya da birini durdurun.

Nasıl çalışır: Lucy hesabınızla giriş yapar, "yalnızca okuma" ya da "okuma ve değiştirme" seçersiniz. Her istek sizin adınıza ve yalnızca kendi Lucy alanınızda çalışır; ChatGPT yalnızca sizin verinizi görür. Her değişiklikten önce ChatGPT size sorar. Bu eklentiyle hiçbir şey silinemez; kayıtların kendisi asla paylaşılmaz, yalnızca metni.

Kimler için: Lucy hesabı olan herkes. Lucy iPhone ve Android için kullanılabilir.

Sınırlar: görev araması son 90 günü kapsar; takvim en fazla 14 gün ileriyi gösterir ve Lucy'ye bağlı bir takvim gerektirir.
